Card Q&A.q: I have 10 or more cards in my trash. Can I use this card’s effect to play 1 purple level 5 Digimon card?

Effect: [Main] Play 1 purple level 5 Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost. If there are 10 or more cards in your trash, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Lucemon] in its name without paying its memory cost instead.
